# Meross Smart Plugs

Read status and switch compatible Meross smart plugs through Muse Home Link, using the signed local HTTP interface (/config endpoint) with an existing device UUID and local key supplied through approved secret storage. It reads Appliance.System.All and supported abilities first and uses only the toggle namespace the device actually exposes. Cloud account/key acquisition is explicitly out of scope; it stops if credentials are missing.
